# Lifecycle Requirements Quality Checklist: Phase 2 — Rendering Lifecycle Extraction

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements on lifecycle correctness, thread safety, resource cleanup and preservation of ProjectM behavior
**Created**: 2026-11-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Depth: standard gate review. Focus areas are given verbatim by the archive prompt, so no clarifying questions were asked.

## Lifecycle Correctness

- [x] CHK001 Are all seven states and every allowed transition specified by reference to one authoritative table? [Completeness, Spec §FR-F203]
- [x] CHK002 Is the behavior for a rejected transition (state unchanged, counted, recorded) specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-F203]
- [x] CHK003 Is the generation rule (when it increments) unambiguous for both first creation and recreation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-F208]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for each exception path: unsupported config, surface failure, scene setup failure, context loss? [Coverage, Spec §FR-F202, §FR-F214, §FR-F215, §FR-F208]
- [x] CHK005 Is the measurable outcome for recreation (100 cycles, generation 101, correct frame) specified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-F202]
- [x] CHK006 Is the behavior of an app-requested pause across a background/foreground cycle specified? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-F207]

## Thread Safety

- [x] CHK007 Is the owning thread for every EGL/GL call stated, and how violations are detected? [Clarity, Spec §FR-F204]
- [x] CHK008 Are requirements for multiple simultaneous hosts and the shared display stated? [Coverage, Spec §FR-F216]
- [x] CHK009 Is it specified that the display is never terminated, and why? [Clarity, Spec §FR-F216]

## Resource Cleanup

- [x] CHK010 Is the teardown order specified with a verifiable post-condition (no host-created surfaces/contexts)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-F209]
- [x] CHK011 Are surface recreation requirements on resize tied to a pixel-size change rather than every layout? [Clarity, Spec §FR-F205]
- [x] CHK012 Is GPU work completion before backgrounding specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-F207]

## Preservation of ProjectM Behavior

- [x] CHK013 Is each re-implemented reference step traced to its audited source (extraction map)? [Traceability, Plan §Extraction map]
- [x] CHK014 Is the regression requirement (reference renderer tests still pass on both runtimes) explicit and measurable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-F213, §SC-F205]
- [x] CHK015 Are intentional differences from the reference (recreation, explicit states) documented as such? [Consistency, contracts render-lifecycle reconciliation]
- [x] CHK016 Is the frame-pacing table consistent with the reference quality governor (30 fps floor, 0.75 at critical)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-F206]

## Notes

- Reviewed 2026-11-10 by the agent as reviewer under the owner's standing approval: 16/16 satisfied by spec (FR-F201–FR-F216, SC-F201–SC-F206), plan extraction map and the feature-002 lifecycle contract.

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
